scope: Recall-only isolated synthetic diagnostic comparison; v3 all exposed; new small closed-world fixture authored by same assistant, not human/unseen acceptance

target_rule.identifiers: Literal ASCII tokens with digits/underscore/path punctuation, camelCase or uppercase abbreviations;2..64chars
target_rule.phrases: Explicit curly/Chinese corner/backtick/ASCII double quoted spans2..32chars only; no dictionary or model extraction
target_rule.dedup: Literal text, preserve first occurrence; quoted phrases precede identifiers
target_rule.fields: same content.cjk or retrieval_text.cjk field as existing mandatory match
target_rule.filters: same active generation and existing ACL/publication/revision hydration
target_rule.limitations: Analyzer-level adjacency/case folding can collapse punctuation and case; this is not byte-exact identifier equality

pairing.shared_index: One seeding/index for all3 modes and both repetitions within each dataset
pairing.order: Rotate mode order by question index; reverse it in repetition2; serial individual requests
pairing.durability: Separate trace files per mode/repeat; checkpoints every25 questions; preserve partial evidence on failure

metrics: per-evidence gains/losses at keyword raw/retained, merged pool and final selection
keyword first5 evidence recall and evidence reciprocal rank
v3 overall and triggered subsets; all split groups retained as exposed regression
small closed-world fixture strict source precision@1/3/5, literal collision probes and per-case ranks; do not generalize to v3 precision
off repeat stability; semantic and untargeted-query controls; no production timing claim
decision: One pass through frozen3 modes x2 repeats on both datasets; do not tune targets, boosts or gold after results
Require repeat-consistent keyword ranking/evidence gains without new pool or final evidence loss; focused-only gains are not broad production adoption
Keep off if gains are absent, unstable or come with regressions; record and stop this direction
Do not change business defaults, schema/indexed text, chunks, cross-route fusion, reranker or answer generation
